description:
Draw random would-you-rather questions from RedBison's original question bank, filtered by audience (kids, family, work, party), with no repeats within one call.

Returns: JSON { audience[], available, questions[{ id, question, a, b, tags[] }] }.
Example input: {"audience":["work"],"count":3}
On error, includes hint: Audiences: kids, family, work, party. count is capped at the number of matching questions.

audience.description: Audiences to include; a question tagged with any of them qualifies. Omit for all.

count.description: How many questions (default 5, capped at the number available).

name: would_you_rather
title: Would you rather questions
